gloss: to be deeply impressed; to admire greatly

definitions.gloss: to be deeply impressed; to admire greatly; to be filled with admiration
definitions.explanation: To feel deep admiration or respect for someone's skill, effort, character, or achievement. A somewhat formal expression that conveys genuine, heartfelt admiration.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{努力|どりょく}に{感服|かんぷく}した。
examples.english: I was deeply impressed by his effort.

examples.japanese: その{職人|しょくにん}の{技|わざ}には{感服|かんぷく}するばかりだ。
examples.english: I can only admire that craftsman's skill.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}な{状況|じょうきょう}でも{前向|まえむ}きに{取|と}り{組|く}む{姿勢|しせい}に{感服|かんぷく}しました。
examples.english: I was deeply impressed by the positive attitude of tackling things even in difficult situations.

notes: A suru verb ({感服|かんぷく}しない / {感服|かんぷく}します / {感服|かんぷく}して). More formal and emphatic than {感心|かんしん}する (to be impressed). {感服|かんぷく} implies a deep, almost reverent admiration, while {感心|かんしん} is milder. Common patterns: ～に{感服|かんぷく}する (to be impressed by ~), {感服|かんぷく}するばかりだ (I can only admire), {感服|かんぷく}いたしました (I'm truly impressed — humble form).
